svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Alert Lens for INC-2041 (3D-first hybrid)
svg.desc: Alert Lens for INC-2041 Checkout degraded, SEV2, firing since 12:22:50, at the 12:30 state. An impact line reads about 9% of purchases failing, about €38k per hour at risk, 2 900 users per 10 minutes and SLO burn 14×, followed by the causal sentence. The hero is the incident’s 3D mini-world: a compact floors scene with the application floor as glass over the prod-eu-1 infrastructure floor. The causal path gateway → checkout → payments → ⊕ psp-api is lit on the app floor with victims ringed and dashed, psp-api Failing with the origin beacon and a dotted call to psp-a outside the estate; a magenta runs-on thread drops from psp-api to node ip-10-4-3-12 whose psp-api client pod slabs glow. Every other service and node is in fog. A docked 2D impact strip under the scene plots purchases failing with the −7d ghost and follows the scene selection. Below are First Light onset lanes and the 14 merged alerts; on the right the root-cause analysis card with confidence HIGH 0.86, H1 the 12:19 timeout config change confirmed, five evidence lines that light their entity in the scene, ruled-out items and a suggested revert. The action bar carries Revert config, Ack (Shift+A), Escalate, Silence and Open investigation INV-2041.

g.text: ~9% of purchases failing · ~€38k/h at risk · ≈ 2 900 users / 10 min · SLO burn 14×
